panels.title: Total Camera Positions
panels.description: Camera positions are computed during reconstruction. More positions = more coverage = better relocalization potential.

panels.title: Avg Cameras/Map
panels.description: Average camera positions per map. Maps with very few cameras (<5) may have poor coverage for relocalization.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(round(avg(cnt)), 0) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS cnt FROM localization_map_camera_positions GROUP BY localization_map_id) sub;

panels.title: Maps with <10 Cameras
panels.description: Maps with fewer than 10 camera positions have limited coverage and may produce unreliable localizations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT localization_map_id, count(*) AS cnt FROM localization_map_camera_positions GROUP BY localization_map_id HAVING count(*) < 10) sub;

panels.title: Total Spatial Volume (m^3)
panels.description: Approximate total spatial volume covered by all active maps combined (bounding box sum).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(vol), 0) FROM (SELECT (max(cp.position_x) - min(cp.position_x)) * (max(cp.position_y) - min(cp.position_y)) * (max(cp.position_z) - min(cp.position_z)) AS vol FROM localization_map_camera_positions cp JOIN localization_maps lm ON lm.id = cp.localization_map_id WHERE lm.active = true GROUP BY cp.localization_map_id HAVING count(*) >= 3) sub;
SELECT count(*) FROM localization_maps WHERE active = true;
SELECT count(*) FROM localization_maps WHERE active = false;

panels.title: Map Quality Report
panels.description: Comprehensive per-map analysis: camera count, spatial extent, camera density, device type, and reconstruction status. Low camera density maps may need re-capture.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(lm.name, cs.name, 'map-' || left(lm.id::text, 8)) AS map_name, cs.device_type::text AS device, r.orchestration_status::text AS recon_status, lm.active, COALESCE(cam.cnt, 0) AS cameras, COALESCE(round(cam.extent::numeric, 2), 0) AS extent_m, CASE WHEN cam.vol > 0 THEN round((cam.cnt / cam.vol)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END AS density_per_m3, lm.lighting, lm.created_at FROM localization_maps lm JOIN reconstructions r ON r.id = lm.reconstruction_id JOIN capture_sessions cs ON cs.id = r.capture_session_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) AS cnt, sqrt(power(max(position_x) - min(position_x), 2) + power(max(position_y) - min(position_y), 2) + power(max(position_z) - min(position_z), 2)) AS extent, greatest((max(position_x) - min(position_x)) * (max(position_y) - min(position_y)) * (max(position_z) - min(position_z)), 0.001) AS vol FROM localization_map_camera_positions WHERE localization_map_id = lm.id) cam ON true ORDER BY cam.cnt DESC NULLS LAST;

panels.title: Camera Positions Top-Down (X vs Z)
panels.description: Bird's-eye view of all camera positions across all active maps. Each color represents a different map. Clusters indicate areas with dense coverage; gaps indicate blind spots.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(lm.name, 'map-' || left(lm.id::text, 8)) AS map_name, cp.position_x AS pos_x, cp.position_z AS pos_z FROM localization_map_camera_positions cp JOIN localization_maps lm ON lm.id = cp.localization_map_id WHERE lm.active = true LIMIT 5000;

panels.title: Camera Positions Elevation (X vs Y)
panels.description: Side view showing camera height distribution. Y axis is elevation. Helps identify if maps cover multiple floors or vertical structures.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(lm.name, 'map-' || left(lm.id::text, 8)) AS map_name, cp.position_x AS pos_x, cp.position_y AS pos_y FROM localization_map_camera_positions cp JOIN localization_maps lm ON lm.id = cp.localization_map_id WHERE lm.active = true LIMIT 5000;

panels.title: Camera Count per Map
panels.description: Camera positions per map, sorted by count. Maps at the bottom with few cameras may need recapture.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(lm.name, cs.name, 'map-' || left(lm.id::text, 8)) AS "Map", count(cp.id) AS "Camera Positions" FROM localization_maps lm JOIN reconstructions r ON r.id = lm.reconstruction_id JOIN capture_sessions cs ON cs.id = r.capture_session_id LEFT JOIN localization_map_camera_positions cp ON cp.localization_map_id = lm.id WHERE lm.active = true GROUP BY lm.id, lm.name, cs.name ORDER BY count(cp.id) DESC LIMIT 25;

panels.title: Map Spatial Extent (bounding box diagonal)
panels.description: 3D bounding box diagonal for each map's camera positions. Larger extent = larger physical area covered.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(lm.name, cs.name, 'map-' || left(lm.id::text, 8)) AS "Map", round(sqrt(power(max(cp.position_x) - min(cp.position_x), 2) + power(max(cp.position_y) - min(cp.position_y), 2) + power(max(cp.position_z) - min(cp.position_z), 2))::numeric, 2) AS "Extent (m)" FROM localization_maps lm JOIN reconstructions r ON r.id = lm.reconstruction_id JOIN capture_sessions cs ON cs.id = r.capture_session_id JOIN localization_map_camera_positions cp ON cp.localization_map_id = lm.id WHERE lm.active = true GROUP BY lm.id, lm.name, cs.name HAVING count(cp.id) >= 2 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 25;

panels.title: Camera Height (Y) Distribution by Map
panels.description: Distribution of camera Y coordinates (elevation) per map. Multi-modal distributions indicate multi-floor coverage. Tight distributions indicate single-level capture.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(lm.name, 'map-' || left(lm.id::text, 8)) AS map_name, count(cp.id) AS cameras, round(min(cp.position_y)::numeric, 2) AS min_y, round(avg(cp.position_y)::numeric, 2) AS avg_y, round(max(cp.position_y)::numeric, 2) AS max_y, round((max(cp.position_y) - min(cp.position_y))::numeric, 2) AS height_range, round(stddev(cp.position_y)::numeric, 3) AS stddev_y FROM localization_map_camera_positions cp JOIN localization_maps lm ON lm.id = cp.localization_map_id WHERE lm.active = true GROUP BY lm.id, lm.name HAVING count(cp.id) >= 2 ORDER BY height_range DESC;

panels.title: Inter-Camera Distance Statistics
panels.description: Average nearest-neighbor distance between cameras in each map. Very dense cameras (<0.1m) may indicate redundant frames. Very sparse cameras (>2m) may indicate gaps in coverage.

targets.rawSql: WITH cam_stats AS (SELECT lm.id AS map_id, COALESCE(lm.name, 'map-' || left(lm.id::text, 8)) AS map_name, count(cp.id) AS cameras, round(avg(sqrt(power(cp.position_x, 2) + power(cp.position_y, 2) + power(cp.position_z, 2)))::numeric, 2) AS avg_dist_from_origin, round(stddev(cp.position_x)::numeric, 2) AS spread_x, round(stddev(cp.position_y)::numeric, 2) AS spread_y, round(stddev(cp.position_z)::numeric, 2) AS spread_z FROM localization_map_camera_positions cp JOIN localization_maps lm ON lm.id = cp.localization_map_id WHERE lm.active = true GROUP BY lm.id, lm.name HAVING count(cp.id) >= 3) SELECT map_name, cameras, avg_dist_from_origin, spread_x, spread_y, spread_z FROM cam_stats ORDER BY cameras DESC;

SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS time, CASE WHEN active THEN 'active' ELSE 'inactive' END AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM localization_maps WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '6 months' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT COALESCE(t.name, lm.tenant_id::text) AS "Tenant", count(*) FILTER (WHERE lm.active) AS "Active Maps", count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT lm.active) AS "Inactive Maps" FROM localization_maps lm LEFT JOIN auth.tenants t ON t.id = lm.tenant_id GROUP BY t.name, lm.tenant_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 15;
